Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage first grade 6447036960, verbatim: "**p2, two halves:** the Studio hook editor has no `capabilities` control (ui), and a hook refused for a missing capability answers the client 500, not a named refusal (`domain:server`, a child card filed on claim). ⛔ The capability check stays as strict as it is. … Re-check the landing site on current `main`." No maintainer ruling. **This dispatch is the ui half only**; the seat files the server half as a child card when it claims.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

- On `origin/main` `c4a4aefc`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/HookDefaultInspector.tsx` curates Function (language + body editor), and its docblock says the "js capabilities/timeout/memory" fall through to the collapsed "More fields" SchemaForm. Measure whether that form actually reaches `body.capabilities` for a `language: 'js'` body. The QA run found no control, so the likely answer is that the nested body key is not reachable there.
- The legal tokens are the spec's `HookBodyCapability` (`packages/spec/src/data/hook-body.zod.ts` ≈L48: `api.read`, `api.write`, `api.transaction`, `crypto.uuid`, `log`), and `capabilities` defaults to `[]`. So the likely fix is a curated multi-choice control under Function, shown only for a sandboxed-JS body, that reads its options from the spec enum (not a copied list) and writes `body.capabilities`. "Derive from the body" is not ruled. Do not infer grants from source text. A hint naming the `ctx.*` call each token unlocks is welcome.
- `ObjectHooksPanel.tsx` (the Data › Hooks tab) hosts the inspector; measure whether it needs any change at all.

### Scope

File surface: `HookDefaultInspector.tsx` (+ `ObjectHooksPanel.tsx` only if the host must pass something) + i18n rows for the control (in whatever home holds the inspector's hook family on your base; `engine.inspector.*` lives in the lazy `studio` namespace since #25922 S2/S3, so a zh test preloads with `await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')`) + tests: picking `api.read` writes `body.capabilities: ['api.read']`, and the saved hook parses through the spec's hook schema; clearing writes `[]` or drops the key (match the spec default); an expression-language body shows no control and never writes it; an existing grant round-trips; "More fields" does not edit the same key twice. Ablation: drop the write ⇒ the new tests go red. ⛔ No server or spec change; ⛔ the capability check is not loosened.

### Tier

No path-derived mandate. `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `high` (M). `Clause-②: no` (Studio authors a key the spec already publishes), `Metadata-protocol: none` expected; say otherwise if the diff shows it. Patch changeset for `@object-ui/i18n` if you add namespace rows; none for app-shell (`private: true`).

The Studio hook editor now shows a "Capabilities" checkbox per `HookBodyCapability` token on a sandboxed-JS body, with the `ctx` calls each one unlocks, and writes `body.capabilities` in spec order (`[]` when the last is unticked). The capability check itself is unchanged. The server half, a named refusal instead of a 500, is #26903. `pm:dispatched` is removed with the close.
